people.title: Sir
people.bio: Took the lease of Elmhurst, Cavendish Road East. Park Estate archives record a Notice of Assignment of 24th November 1938 from E. C. Watmough's executors to Sir Arthur Black, and a further Notice of Assignment of 27th June 1939 to Sir Arthur William Black, by which point the property was united with Overdale. A further Notice of Assignment in 1941 passed it on. Identified from the Park Estate archive references quoted in the record for Herbert Durrant Snook at Elmhurst; he had no record of his own.
